title: Titan X Cool Mint Prefilled Pod + Refills
description: The Titan X Refill Kit in Cool Mint is designed for use with the Titan X Prefilled Pod Vape Kit. This refill pack contains a 2ml prefilled mouthpiece pod and three 5ml flavour-matched auto-refill capsules, making it easy to enjoy smooth, consistent vaping with no manual refilling. Just click the pod and capsules into place on your Titan X device and you’re ready to go. The Cool Mint flavour offers a crisp and refreshing Mint profile with a brisk menthol chill on the exhale. The flavour is clean and bright, delivering a cooling mouth-to-lung (MTL) vape sensation that feels fresh without overpowering. Featuring a pre-installed mesh coil for enhanced flavour clarity and vapour production, the Titan X Refill Kit works seamlessly with the Titan X device’s smart auto-refill system. Together, they provide up to approximately 10,000 puffs per refill cycle (usage-dependent), offering dependable performance and great value for daily MTL vapers.
